why: Flat backgrounds prevented the marks being placed on anything but black.

method.MD-Circle-Transparent.png: Circular alpha mask on the seal's own outer ring, supersampled 4x. Only pixels OUTSIDE the ring become transparent; the seal's black interior field is preserved, so the mark itself is unaltered.
method.MD-Hat-Transparent.png: Luminance key of the flat ground with a soft ramp, then un-premultiplied: partially transparent edge pixels have their colour restored to the mark's own gold, so no dark halo survives on light grounds.

guarantee: No pixel of either mark was redrawn, traced, reinterpreted or regenerated. The originals are unmodified and remain the approved assets; these are derivations for placement on non-black grounds.
